input.summary: Cap early termination charges at three months' charges and require refund of prepaid charges.
input.comment: [Playbook] We keep the one-month convenience right, but termination charges must be capped (three months' charges) and prepaid charges refunded pro rata; our position is convenience termination on 30 days' notice without penalty.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, which will not in aggregate exceed three (3) months' charges for the terminated Services. IBM will refund any charges prepaid by Customer for periods after the effective date of termination.

input.summary: Confirm no other liquidated damages or penalties are payable by Customer.
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept liquidated damages or penalties. The capped early termination charge is the only amount payable by us on early exit.

ops.text: The early termination charges referred to in Section 3.4(b), as capped therein, are the sole amounts payable by Customer in connection with any termination, and Customer will not be liable for any other liquidated damages, penalties, minimum charges or similar amounts.

input.summary: Set renewal terms at 12 months and shorten the non-renewal notice window to 30 days.
input.comment: [Playbook] A 90-day window with renewals equal to the prior (potentially multi-year) term is too sticky; we need 12-month renewals with a 30-day opt-out (60 days as a fallback).

ops.oldText: for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior
ops.newText: for successive additional terms of twelve (12) months unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least thirty (30) days prior
